summary: Frontend-only test (backend skipped). I ran Playwright as TestAngler at 1920x1080 and 390x844. 7 of 7 requested features work; I found and fixed 1 bug and found 1 new bug. (1) Water mode: the action bar shows exactly menu-waters, journal, inventory, quests, profile and more; there is no menu-shop. The More modal lists only Quests, Messages and Wiki. Going to /game/shop, /market, /crews, /pearl-shop and /tournaments, or doing a pushState to /game/market, always redirects to /game with the toast "That's in the harbour. Sail back to visit it." The page modal never stays open. (2) Harbour: menu-shop uses /art/hud/tackle.webp (tackle box). The player card uses gold.webp and pearl.webp. The shop has 22 gold.webp and 1 pearl.webp images and 0 lucide coin/gem icons. The wallet shows GOLD 4,577 and PEARLS 0 with image icons. (3) Fight on the Millbrook bridge (1520,1065): cast-fish-button has visibility:hidden (class invisible) during phase=fight, so reel-button is the only reel control. Released and held states keep the same size (560x58) and frame; only the skin changes (btn_dark to btn_gold) and the label ('Hold to reel' / 'Reeling...'). The automated hold/release loop landed a Bluegill and the catch popup showed. (4) Buying 1 Earthworm showed the toast 'Bought 1 × Earthworms' with the panel.webp teak border-image, gold title (#ffd27a) and readable text. Gold went from 4,577 to 4,570. (5) The species modal (Fishdex) and look-dialog both use the teak frame, are readable, and close correctly. (6) In Millbrook ?mapview=1 no tree, reed, lamp, bush or rock stands in the water; the boat sits in the pond on purpose. (7) Chat: the sent message is added to the list from the POST response (about 0.6s after the response, with no 3s poll wait). New bug: a race causes duplicate lines. FIXED: the canvas Tackle Shop signpost in the harbour showed a blank dark square, because Scene.js loaded `art/ui//art/hud/tackle.webp.png`. After my fix it shows the green tackle box.

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate chat lines (reproduced: 'TEST_fast1 7705' appeared twice). A poll GET goes out with the old `after` just before the POST returns. Its response contains the new message, and send() also appends r.data. Rows are not de-duplicated by id.

Each redirect raises 2 identical toasts (seen in the [data-sonner-toast] list). Cause: the effect fires twice under React.StrictMode / re-render. Give it a fixed id, e.g. toast(msg, {id:'harbour-only'}).
FIXED by the testing agent: the Tackle Shop signpost icon was blank because an absolute img path was wrapped in art/ui/...png.

issues: The catch popup shows '6 g' and 'Sell 4 g' as text instead of the gold.webp coin.
Shop bait buy buttons show 'Buy 70g' as text.
Durability.js (repair price) and SellDialog.js still use the lucide <Coins> icon instead of gold.webp.
PearlShop.js uses the lucide <Gem> in its header.
The hint 'Walk onto a glowing fishing spot to cast' still overlaps the collapsed chat box (issue carried over from iteration 10).
Bluegill is a blue-striped fish on the catch card but a golden fish in the Fishdex species modal. The art is inconsistent (it looks like the FishPlate hue-rotate is applied differently).
The 'Your angler' title sits right on top of the 'ANGLER' label; it needs a few px of spacing.

action_items: ChatBox.js: de-duplicate rows by id when appending (in both pull and send), e.g. setRows(old => old.some(x => x.id === m.id) ? old : [...old, m]).
World.js harbour-only redirect: use toast(msg, { id: 'harbour-only' }) so only one toast shows.
Replace the remaining text 'g' and lucide Coins/Gem with the <Gold>/<PearlIcon> components (CatchCard, Shop BaitBuy button, Durability.js, SellDialog.js, PearlShop header).
Mobile: move the hint above the chat box, or hide it when they overlap.
critical_code_review_comments: World.js: the HARBOUR_ONLY redirect runs in an effect after render, so the page modal and its <Outlet/> mount for one frame (and may fire the page's API calls) before the redirect. Checking the guard before rendering the Modal would avoid this.
ChatBox.js: send() moves last.current forward, but a pull already in flight can still append the same message, so you get duplicates (see ui_bugs).
Scene.js signpost loader assumed every sp.img is a short key. maps.js now mixes keys and absolute paths; I patched the loader to accept both.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (all 7 requested features pass; 1 new medium chat dedupe bug and a few polish items)

seed_data_creation: Posted Global chat messages TEST_instant*, TEST_api check, TEST_fast0/1 as TestAngler. Bought 1 Earthworm (-7 gold). Landed and kept 1 Bluegill on Millbrook.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: POST /api/auth/login, then set localStorage owo_token and sessionStorage fr_mode (water/harbour). Fight: in water mode, set window.__fx.me={...,x:1520,y:1065}, then dispatch pointerdown on cast-fish-button. Hold/release by comparing the tension-needle style.left with the tension-zone-box left+width/2 (mouse down/up). TestAngler gold is about 4,570.
